title: Production version baseline
content: RouteCodex V3 is the only active production implementation. V4 is a refactor of V3 and is not connected to the production baseline. V2 runtime, V2 config-reader ownership, V2 migration paths, and V2 backups are retired and must not be restored.

title: Skeleton and plane ownership
content: RouteCodex uses a fixed runtime skeleton plus typed configuration declarations. Business payload data and control-plane resources are physically separate; control truth is carried only by typed control resources or the Error chain.

title: Payload rewrite owners
content: Payload rewriting has exactly two mode-specific owners: Direct rewrites only through registered Direct hooks, while Relay rewrites only inside request/response Chat Process. Inbound, Outbound, Compat, Provider, SSE, buffering, routing, and Error stages do not own general payload rewriting.

title: Client and Provider decoupling
content: SSE is the client communication boundary and is decoupled from Provider. Direct and Relay provider attempts pass through the runtime provider transport relay, are fully buffered through a protocol terminal, and only then produce a committed client response. Provider errors enter the Error chain independently of client response projection.
